g.text: F8 | conditional uncapped-connector analysis (experiments_condshare/): every parking space is a charging berth
(k = n_spaces), 22 kW per connector, feeder = k x 22 kW, same three constraints, no future information. Unit =
held-out stream (site-day), 20 streams, policy A. Gate rejection is 0/137 because no connector is scarce; the
unmet share is entirely shortfall sessions whose observed dwell is shorter than the scenario charging time.
